row.evidence: WEDO's pricing page lists "User Provisioning & Deprovisioning (SCIM)" and SAML 2.0 SSO only under the Enterprise plan (CHF 28.- / user / month).
row.notes: Still gated. Prices changed: the site moved from wedo.swiss to wedo.com and now lists Pro CHF 21.- and Enterprise CHF 28.- per user per month (June: CHF 19.90 and 24.90), with a currency toggle showing USD $21 and $28, so USD figures now come from the page instead of a CHF conversion. Billing period is not stated on the page. WEDO publishes no SCIM or API documentation of its own; SCIM details (tenant URL and token from WEDO support, attribute list) come from Microsoft's Entra provisioning tutorial, and Okta's OIN lists a SCIM app with create, update and deactivate.

plans.notes: SSO, SCIM and audit logs are listed only on Enterprise.

auth.notes: From Microsoft's Entra tutorial; Entra calls it a long-lived bearer token.

operations.notes: Okta OIN: create, update, deactivate. Entra tutorial: create, remove, keep attributes in sync.

limitations.text: WEDO publishes no SCIM documentation of its own; the tenant URL and token must be requested from WEDO support.

user_api.notes: Features page mentions a public API for custom integrations, but no API reference or user-management endpoints were found on wedo.com.

okta.notes: OIN marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate.

entra.notes: Entra provisioning tutorial requires a WEDO Enterprise subscription and maps userName (matching), displayName, title, emails[type eq "work"].value, name.givenName, name.familyName, active, preferredLanguage and userType.
